reasons: Mostly constant values, and no tests are visible in this packet.
Depends on the brand file being present.

terms.meaning: Passing a value through from another file, so other files can import it from one place.
A named colour or style value kept in one shared place.
A small label at the top right of a slide, such as PRELIMINARY.
A list of fonts the browser tries in order until one is available.

sections.name: File setup
sections.title: Shared colours and font
sections.what: Passes the house colours from the shared colour file through to slides, and sets the Arial font list used on every scan slide.
sections.why: The comment says the house font is Arial, matching the master deck, and that colours live in one shared file.
sections.watch_out: Slides get colours only through this file, so a colour added to the shared file is not visible here until it is added to this list.

sections.name: HOUSE_TAGS_PRELIMINARY
sections.title: Status tags for content slides
sections.what: Defines the two tags shown at the top right of the bubble, glossary and reasons slides: NON EXHAUSTIVE and PRELIMINARY.
sections.why: Warns the reader that the data is incomplete and not final.
sections.watch_out: These tags make a claim about the data's completeness, so changing them changes what readers are told.

sections.name: HOUSE_TAGS_DIRECTIONAL
sections.title: Directional tags and footer text
sections.what: Defines the three tags for the AI synthesis slide: NON EXHAUSTIVE, ILLUSTRATIVE and DIRECTIONAL. Also passes through the confidential footer text and the house wordmark from the brand file.
sections.why: The synthesis is an AI summary, so it carries stronger warning labels than the data slides.
sections.watch_out: The footer text is shared by every content slide, so a wording change applies to all of them at once.

summary: The single entry point for the house look of the scan slides: colours, font, status tag sets and footer text.
purpose: Keeps the house style inside the scan deck so the rest of the app is unaffected.
why: The header comment says slide components should get the house look only through this file, and the wider app theme must not change.
how: 1. Passes the shared house colours through from the colour file. 2. Sets the Arial font list used on slides. 3. Defines the status tag sets for content slides and the directional slide. 4. Takes the confidential footer text and the wordmark from the brand file.
inputs: The shared colour file and the brand file.
outputs: Named constants (colours, font, tag lists, footer text, wordmark) for slide components to import.
risks: Changing a tag list or the footer text changes every slide that uses it at once. The brand file must exist, or the footer and wordmark are blank.
debug: If a slide shows the wrong colour, check the shared colour file and whether that slide imports from this file. If the footer or wordmark is wrong, check the brand file.
